result.markdown: --- title: "[Graph.list_triangles()]{.doc-object-name .doc-function .doc-label .doc-label-method}" body-classes: doc-api-page doc-py-api-page shift-heading-level-by: 0 toc-depth: 3 page-navigation: false html-table-processing: none --- ::: {.doc-subject} List all triangles in the graph. ::: ::: {.doc-usage-source} Usage [Source](https://github.com/rich-iannone/edgecase/blob/main/python/edgecase/graph.py#L9933-L9995){target="_blank" rel="noopener"} ::: ::: {.doc-signature .doc-Kind.FUNCTION} ```python Graph.list_triangles() ``` ::: ::: {.doc-text} Returns a list of all triangles (3-cycles) in the graph. Each triangle is represented as a sorted tuple of three node IDs. For undirected graphs, each triangle appears once. For directed graphs, lists directed triangles. Time complexity: `O(m * d_max)` where `m` is edges and `d_max` is maximum degree. ::: ## Returns {.doc-returns} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [list[tuple[int, int, int]]]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : List of triangles, where each triangle is a tuple of three node IDs. ::: ## Examples {.doc-examples} Each triangle is reported as a tuple of its three node IDs -- here, two triangles both sharing the "A"-"B" edge: ::: {#88cdf897 .cell execution_count=1} ``` {.python .cell-code} import edgecase as ec graph = ( ec.Graph() .add_node(label="A") .add_node(label="B") .add_node(label="C") .add_node(label="D") .add_edge(source="A", target="B") .add_edge(source="B", target="C") .add_edge(source="C", target="A") # One triangle .add_edge(source="A", target="D") .add_edge(source="D", target="B") # Another triangle ) triangles = graph.list_triangles() [tuple(graph.get_label_from_id(nid) for nid in tri) for tri in triangles] ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=1} ``` [('A', 'B', 'C'), ('A', 'B', 'D')] ``` ::: ::: This makes it straightforward to identify every triadic closure in a larger network -- for example, listing all mutual-friend groups in a small social graph: ::: {#8a9a5055 .cell execution_count=2} ``` {.python .cell-code} graph = ( ec.Graph() .add_node(label="Alice") .add_node(label="Bob") .add_node(label="Charlie") .add_node(label="David") .add_edge(source="Alice", target="Bob") .add_edge(source="Bob", target="Charlie") .add_edge(source="Charlie", target="Alice") .add_edge(source="Alice", target="David") .add_edge(source="David", target="Bob") ) [tuple(graph.get_label_from_id(nid) for nid in tri) for tri in graph.list_triangles()] ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=2} ``` [('Alice', 'Bob', 'Charlie'), ('Alice', 'Bob', 'David')] ``` ::: :::
